title: Moka pot
description: An original twelve-sided stovetop espresso maker in cast aluminium for 3, 4 or 6 cups, sized by its physics: the safety valve sits where the water for the cups ends, the funnel holds the coffee for that water, the lid opens on a working hinge, and the pot stands on a 10° slope full or empty.
process: Die casting with sand cores, turning, pressing, moulding

difficulty.rationale: Ten coupled bodies, closed-form physics, measured sand cores, centre-of-mass stability, a hinge swing check and kernel limits worked around; no freeform surfacing.

materials: Cast aluminium to EN 601, satin (boiler, collector, lid)
Pressed aluminium sheet to EN 602 (funnel, filter plate)

prompt_test.model: Claude Sonnet 5.5, medium effort, through craft3d-cli
prompt_test.result: Passed: water 150.000 mL, basket 45.43 mL (dose 45.45), collector 165.0 mL, 217 and 91 holes, funnel end 3.0 mm up, fill line 33.94 mm, all as this example's; lid turns 90° clear; 25 checks pass at 3/4/6 cups and 0°/30°; 580 g against 585 g; about 310 steps.
